record.title: Guinea-Bissau COVID land-border closure, March 2020
record.scope: National land-border component of a wider land, sea and air closure
record.crossings: Mpack–São Domingos implementation documented; other posts not individually verified
record.direction: National restriction; observed refusals include travel from Senegal into Guinea-Bissau.
record.movement: Ordinary travellers and passenger transport; fish vendors were turned back at Mpack.
record.exceptions: Medical evacuations, medicine supplies and essential food imports were excepted; treatment of small traders was uneven.
record.enforcement: Mpack traffic was stopped and passengers returned from Ziguinchor bus station.
record.consequences: Interrupted journeys and petty trade; no quantified regional loss established.
record.relationship: Separate imposing authority from Senegal’s W-023. The shared Mpack frontier must not be counted twice in border-day totals. Guinea’s later W-006 security closure is a different regime.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; not a present-day status assessment
record.context: Announced on 17 March for the following day. Mpack evidence records local enforcement on 19 March.
record.uncertainty: Do not use 17 March announcement as the effective date, or Mpack’s 19 March implementation as the national onset. Air-service resumption and later general reopening language do not fix the land endpoint.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. Effective order 18 March; observed Mpack closure 19 March. Land reopening remains unknown; no duration to cutoff inferred.
